descript.abstract: This raster dataset represents ecoregions from Olson et al. 2001 modified by Helmer et al. 2019 for cloud forest regions.
descript.purpose: This raster data set is part of the research described in Helmer, E.H., E. A. Gerson, L. S. Baggett , B. Bird, T. S. Ruzycki , S. M. Voggesser. 2019. Neotropical cloud forests and páramo to contract and dry from declines in cloud immersion and frost. PLOS ONE. This work predicts current and predicted future cloud forest and paramo extent, based on current and predicted future climate information.
